info.name: Mastercard Bill Payment Validator Account Opening Registrations API
Create a list of Primary Account Numbers(PAN's) or add Primary Account Numbers to an existing list.

items.docs:
This endpoint allows Issuers to create a new PAN List by providing the name of the PAN List, Account Range details, and a set of PANs. The same endpoint can also be used to add more PANs to a previously created list. Refer to request examples to understand different scenarios.
